title: handRefill
description: This plugin refills your hand with blocks from your inventory when you've used the last block in your hand
body:
This is a plugin for paper servers.

When you've placed the last block in your hand, your hand will get refilled with the same block if you have it in your inventory.

Players can type `/refill` to toggle the plugin off and on.
